lines.en: label sanaspring5:
Meanwhile...
lines.zh: 与此同时……

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar1
: Cancer? Really?
lines.zh: : 癌症？真的？

lines.en: : Yeah. So please don’t hold it against Yuki for crashing out and spiraling into her old ways even if it did cause you to work a little later sometimes.
lines.zh: : 嗯。所以就算 Yuki 崩溃、又滑回老样子，害你有时候得加班，也请别怪她。

lines.en: : Again, I don’t really care about that. It’s my mom who’s upset. But I imagine that’ll all change the moment she has a reason to forgive her.
lines.zh: : 我再说一次，我其实不在乎那个。不高兴的是我妈。不过我想等她有了原谅她的理由，一切都会改变的。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar2

: She really likes Yuki for some reason. Which isn’t to say I don’t. It was just always a little weird to me how willing she was to give her the benefit of the doubt despite knowing where she came from.
lines.zh: : 不知为什么她真的很喜欢 Yuki。倒不是说我不喜欢。只是我一直觉得有点奇怪，明知道 Yuki 的出身，她却那么愿意先往好处想。

lines.en: : I might just be jaded because I know her daughter, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我这么愤世嫉俗，大概只是因为我认识她女儿。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar3
: I guess this kind of explains Yumi’s behavior too, now that you mention it. She’s seemed, like...less of a lone wolf lately. Maybe she’s just afraid of dying alone too?
lines.zh: : 你这么一说，Yumi 的行为大概也解释得通了。她最近看起来……不那么孤僻了。也许她也只是害怕孤独地死去？

lines.en: : She’s not dying, Sana. Not unless something suddenly takes a turn for the worse.
lines.zh: : 她不会死的，Sana。除非情况突然恶化。

lines.en: : That’s good. My mom doesn’t handle death well, as I’m sure you’ve noticed. And I guess it’ll keep Yumi mostly normal too.
lines.zh: : 那就好。我妈不太会面对死亡，你肯定也看出来了。而且我想这也能让 Yumi 大体保持正常。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar4
: You probably didn’t realize it because you were too busy having sex with girls who aren’t me, but she was actually kind of social at our last Christmalloween party.
lines.zh: : 你大概没注意到，因为你忙着和那些不是我的女孩做爱，不过上次圣诞万圣派对上她还挺合群的。

lines.en: : I actually managed to have a whole conversation with her without her threatening me in any way. It was just also a very strange conversation that made me think she might be on drugs too now.
lines.zh: : 我居然真的跟她完整聊了一次，全程没被她威胁。只不过那也是一场非常奇怪的对话，让我怀疑她是不是也开始嗑药了。

lines.en: : Strange...how, exactly? Because I imagine she hasn’t been in her right mind lately either.
lines.zh: : 奇怪……具体怎么个奇怪法？因为我猜她最近脑子也不太清醒。

lines.en: : Just stuff about time and whether or not I noticed anything changing lately. It was just odd because I’ve never really looked at her as a conspiracy theorist.
lines.zh: : 就是些关于时间、还有问我最近有没有注意到什么变化之类的话。奇怪是因为，我从来没把她当成过阴谋论者。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar5
...Huh.
I guess even Yumi’s putting her best foot forward now. I had no idea.
lines.zh: 看来连 Yumi 都开始努力向前的。我完全不知道。

lines.en: And with Nodoka and even Uta somehow gaining awareness of all this time stuff, it might not be long until Sana does too.
lines.zh: 再加上 Nodoka、甚至 Uta 都莫名其妙地察觉到了所有这些时间的事，也许用不了多久 Sana 也会。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar6
: ...What?
: Nothing really. Just thinking about how to escape this plane of existence and move onto a new one where it’s possible for things to be good.
lines.zh: : 也没什么。只是在想怎么逃离这个存在的层面，去到一个新的层面——在那里，事情还有可能是好的。

lines.en: : Can they not be good here? Is the hole you’ve dug yourself too big to escape at this point?
lines.zh: : 在这里就不可能是好的吗？你给自己挖的洞，现在已经大到爬不出来了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s hard to come back from having my face broadcast to however many followers Niki has while simultaneously sleeping with basically everyone else I know.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我的脸被转播给了 Niki 那不知道多少粉丝，同时我还和基本上所有认识的人睡过——这种局面很难翻身。

lines.en: : You did this to yourself by getting caught with her sister instead of me that one time.
lines.zh: : 那是你自找的，谁让你那次被她姐姐撞见，而不是被我撞见。

lines.en: : I somehow don’t think that would be any better, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得那样也不会好到哪儿去，Sana。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar7
: No, but it’d sure be hot. So hot, in fact, that I think we should do it right here, right now, and risk getting caught by my mom and Yuki when they come back downstairs.
lines.zh: : 是不会，但肯定很带劲。带劲到我觉��我们现在就在这儿做吧，哪怕冒着被我妈和 Yuki 下楼时撞见的风险。

lines.en: : I came here to help a recovering addict apologize to her friend and reveal her cancer diagnosis and you’re trying to have sex with me?
lines.zh: : 我来这儿是帮一个正在戒瘾的人向她的朋友道歉、并说出她的癌症诊断的，而你却想和我做爱？

lines.en: : Mhm.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。

lines.en: : Mhm?
lines.zh: : 嗯哼？

lines.en: : I think you have a problem.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你有问题。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar8
: Mhm~
lines.zh: : 嗯哼~

lines.en: : Not tonight, okay? I’d like to just sit here and hang out with you like we used to. Before everything got all...complicated and weird.
lines.zh: : 今晚不行，好吗？我只想像从前那样坐在这儿和你待着。在一切变得这么……复杂又奇怪之前。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar9
: Fine...Then maybe I’ll just...cover my face with my hair again and...start talking all...slowly and...quietly...
lines.zh: : 好吧……那我也许就……再用头发把脸遮起来……然后开始说话……慢吞吞地……轻声细语地……

lines.en: : I’m just an...innocent little girl who...doesn’t even know what a lesbian is...
lines.zh: : 我只是个……天真的小女孩……连女同性恋是什么都不知道……

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar10
scene sanasenseicouchbar11
scene sanasenseicouchbar12
: Sana, I know you were never really being yourself back then, but I know at least some of that was genuine. You haven’t been acting the entire time you’ve known me and I’m not going to believe that.
lines.zh: : Sana，我知道你从前也不是真的在做自己，但我知道那当中至少有一部分是真心的。你认识我的这段时间里并不是一直在演戏，这我可不信。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar13
: Most of it was genuine. I’m not lying when I say you helped me come out of my shell. And I’m sure Ayane would tell you the same.
lines.zh: : 大部分是真的。我说你帮我走出了自己的壳，不是在撒谎。而且我敢肯定 Ayane 也会这么说。

lines.en: : Sure, I may have hammed it up a bit and pretended to be more aloof than I actually was, but you were still talking to Sana back then. Just like you’re talking to Sana now.
lines.zh: : 当然，我可能演得夸张了点，装得比实际的自己更冷淡，可你那时交谈的对象依然是 Sana。就像你现在交谈的对象也是 Sana。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar14
: The main difference is I don’t have to pretend not to like you anymore. I can be honest about my feelings now...and remind you again that I want to be with you forever.
lines.zh: : 主要的区别是，我不用再装作不喜欢你了。我现在可以坦白自己的感情……然后再提醒你一次，我想永远和你在一起。

lines.en: : Or rather that we will be together forever. Just neither one of us really gets how or why yet when we’re still struggling to say what it is we really want to say.
lines.zh: : 或者不如说，我们会永远在一起。只是我们两个都还不太明白这要怎么发生、为什么会发生，因为我们都还在艰难地想说出真正想说的话。

lines.en: : I did say something once.
lines.zh: : 我说过一次的。

lines.en: : And then you took it back.
lines.zh: : 然后你又收回去了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, your reaction wasn’t exactly what I was expecting.
lines.zh: : 是啊，唉，你的反应可不太符合我的预期。

lines.en: : I was a virgin being split in half by a dick the size of my bicep. I’m sorry for being taken by surprise and not being able to respond right away.
lines.zh: : 我当时是个被一根有我二头肌那么大的鸡巴劈成两半的处女。抱歉我当时猝不及防，没能立刻回应。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry for saying it in the first place.
lines.zh: : 而我抱歉自己当初说出口了。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar15
: And now we’re both apologizing. This whole building is full of people apologizing right now. Everything’s just so...sad all the time now.
lines.zh: : 然后现在我们两个都在道歉。这整栋楼现在全是正在道歉的人。一切……不知怎么就是那么……悲伤。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar16
: I want to go back to the old days too...I’d do so many things differently.
lines.zh: : 我也想回到从前……有好多事我会换个做法。

lines.en: : You used to come here so often. And I would always look forward to seeing you. Which...I still do, obviously. It just...feels like a race now.
lines.zh: : 你以前来这儿来得那么勤。而我总是盼着见到你。当然……我现在也盼着。只是……现在感觉像一场赛跑。

lines.en: : Like I need to work harder every time I see you to prove that I am worth your time. But confidence alone doesn’t cut it.
lines.zh: : 就像每次见你我都要更努力，才能证明我值得你花时间。可光有自信是不够的。

lines.en: : Is that why you’re always trying to have sex with me now?
lines.zh: : 所以你现在才老是想和我做爱？

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar17
: No. That’s because I’m an insatiable pervert and sex-addict in training.
lines.zh: : 不是。那是因为我是个永远吃不饱的变态，还是个见习中的性瘾者。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad there’s still something I can teach you. I just wish it was something we could be more public about.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴自己还有能教你的东西。只是我希望那是件我们可以更公开一点的事。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar18
: The chances of us being public at all are...pretty slim now that everyone thinks you’re dating Niki though, huh?
lines.zh: : 不过既然现在所有人都觉得你在和 Niki 交往，我们能公开的机会……就相当渺茫了吧？

lines.en: : I am dating her, Sana. It’s not a charade. I’m in love with her, and I have been since we were kids.
lines.zh: : 我确实在和她交往，Sana。那不是演戏。我爱她，从我们还是孩子的时候就爱。

lines.en: : So you can say it about her right to my face but you still won’t say it to me.
lines.zh: : 所以你可以当着我的面把那句话说给她听，却依然不肯对我说。

lines.en: : As far as I’m concerned, I already did. It’s your turn if you really want something to be said.
lines.zh: : 在我看来，我已经说过了。如果你真想听到什么，该轮到你了。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar19
: So that’s how it is.
lines.zh: : 原来是这么回事。

lines.en: : Guess I’ll keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 那我就记着吧。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m letting you go any time soon, so I’ll have plenty of time to find the words.
lines.zh: : 反正我也没打算近期放你走，所以我有的是时间把话找出来。

lines.en: : You don’t understand just how right you are, Sana.
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道自己说得有多对，Sana。

lines.en: : I don’t really understand anything anymore. I just do whatever I want and hope that nobody smites me.
lines.zh: : 我已经什么都不明白了。我只是想做什么就做什么，然后希望没人降天惩罚我。

lines.en: : Then, am I smiting you right now by telling you we can’t have sex?
lines.zh: : 那么，我现在告诉你我们不能做爱，是在降天惩罚你吗？

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar20
: In a sense, yes. I suppose you are. But I can probably find it within myself to forgive you if you’ll at least put your arm around me or something.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上，是的。我想是的。不过如果你至少愿意搂着我什么的，我大概能找到原谅你的余地。

lines.en: : You’re really craving attention tonight, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你今晚真的很渴求关注，是吧？

lines.en: : I crave it every night. I just feel obligated to let you sleep so you don’t die from overdosing on me.
lines.zh: : 我每晚都渴求。我只是觉得自己有义务让你睡觉，免得你因为对我过量而死去。

lines.en: : Probably not the best words to use when Yuki’s upstairs still apologizing for her existence.
lines.zh: : 在 Yuki 还在楼上为自己的存在道歉的时候，这么说可不太合适。

lines.en: : Just a little hit, Sensei. That’s all I ask.
lines.zh: : 就一小口，老师。我就只求这个。

lines.en: scene black
scene sanasenseicouchbar21
: You’re lucky you’re cute. I wouldn’t tolerate that from someone who wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 幸好你可爱。换个人我可不惯着。

lines.en: : Ooooh, two arms. Be careful or I might cum.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，两只胳膊。小心点，不然我可能会高潮。

lines.en: : I always have to be careful with you when you’re the weight of a small dog. One wrong move could shatter you into a million pieces.
lines.zh: : 对你这种只有小狗那么重的姑娘，我什么时候都得小心。一步走错，你就可能碎成百万片。

lines.en: : Sounds fun. Maybe I should throw myself at you and see how long it takes before I crack.
lines.zh: : 听起来挺好玩的。也许我该朝你扑过去，看看多久会裂开。

lines.en: : Or maybe we can stay like this and just...look at each other.
lines.zh: : 或者我们可以就这么待着，只是……看着彼此。

lines.en: : You don’t even want to kiss? Should I get you more drunk first if I want to have some fun?
lines.zh: : 你连吻都不想要？如果我想找点乐子，是不是该先把你灌得更醉一点？

lines.en: : I just want to hold you for now. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我现在只想抱着你。就这样。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar22

: Hm...I guess I have no choice but to let you, then. A girl my size obviously couldn’t fight back, of course. And if I tried, I imagine it would anger you and you’d be forced to hold me even tighter.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我看来别无选择，只能让你抱了。我这种体型的女孩显然反抗不了，当然。而我要是试着反抗，我想会惹怒你，然后你就不得不再把我抱得更紧。

lines.en: : You’re still looking at me, right?
lines.zh: : 你还在看着我，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Okay. Just making sure.
lines.zh: : 好。只是确认一下。

lines.en: : Sana...Do you really-
lines.zh: : Sana……你真的——

lines.en: : Yes, Sensei. I really do see us together ten years from now.
lines.zh: : 是的，老师。我真的能看到十年后的我们在一起。

lines.en: : I’d just rather leave out the context...
lines.zh: : 只是我宁愿省掉那个背景……

lines.en: : How did you know what I was going to ask?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我要问什么？

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar23
: Would you believe me if I said we’ve been here before?
lines.zh: : 如果我说我们以前来过这里，你会信吗？

lines.en: : Weirdly enough, I actually think I would.
lines.zh: : 说来奇怪，我觉得我真的会信。

lines.en: : Then let’s go with that. It makes me a little less creepy if it’s a memory and not me reading your mind.
lines.zh: : 那就这么说吧。如果是记忆、而不是我在读你的心，那我就不那么变态了。

lines.en: : I already have one Yasu. I don’t need another.
lines.zh: : 我已经有一个 Yasu 了。不需要再来一个。

lines.en: : How many Sanas do you need? Asking for a friend.
lines.zh: : 那你需要几个 Sana？替朋友问的。

lines.en: : One is probably fine in regard to that as well when I can barely even keep up with you.
lines.zh: : 这方面大概一个也够了，毕竟我光是跟上你就够呛了。

lines.en: : You’ve got my mom too. Don’t forget about her.
lines.zh: : 你还有我妈呢。别忘了她。

lines.en: : I assumed you’d rather forget about her after the whole condom fiasco all those years ago.
lines.zh: : 我还以为经过那么多年前那档避孕套的事之后，你宁愿把她忘掉。

lines.en: : I still don’t believe those weren’t yours, by the way. Even if we’ve done it raw every single time.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我到现在也不信那些不是你的。尽管我们每次都是无套做的。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar24
: Believe whatever you want. That was years ago at this point and I’d rather not get into another argument over it when your jealousy is only slightly less powerful than Ami’s.
lines.zh: : 你爱信什么信什么。那都是好几年前的事了，我可不想再为这个吵一架，何况你的嫉妒心只比 Ami 稍微弱一点。

lines.en: : I’m a very jealous girl, yes. But I don’t blame you for having sex with my mom when I was busy playing hard-to-get for so long. She’s the next best thing. Just be happy you can have both now.
lines.zh: : 是的，我是个很爱吃醋的女孩。但我并不怪你在我忙着欲擒故纵那么久的时候和我妈做爱。她是退而求其次的最佳选择。你该高兴的是现在两个都能要到。

lines.en: : Yes, and I’m sure you’re very happy about competition existing between you and both of the girls you’re closest to.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我敢肯定你非常乐意在你和你最亲近的两个女孩之间存在竞争。

lines.en: : Competition, huh? Then tell me, who’s the best between me, my mom, and Ayane?
lines.zh: : 竞争，是吗？那告诉我，我、我妈和 Ayane 之间谁最棒？

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar25
: Best at what?
lines.zh: : 在哪方面最棒？

lines.en: : Mmmm...sex in general.
lines.zh: : 嗯……总体上的性爱。

lines.en: : Ayane.
lines.zh: : Ayane。

lines.en: : Blowjobs?
lines.zh: : 口交呢？

lines.en: : Your mom.
lines.zh: : 你妈。

lines.en: : Okay, fine. Just cut to the chase and tell me what I’m the best at.
lines.zh: : 行吧，好吧。干脆直说，告诉我我最擅长什么。

lines.en: : Teasing, dirty talk, and cowgirl. You’re also the tightest, which I am sure you are very proud of.
lines.zh: : 挑逗、脏话和女上位。你也是最紧的那个，这一点我相信你非常自豪。

lines.en: : Good answer. I suppose I will let you live. For now.
lines.zh: : 答得好。我就暂且饶你不死吧。目前。

lines.en: : I did not realize my life was at stake.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道自己的命还悬着。

lines.en: : There are a lot of things you don’t realize yet, Sensei. And most of them are about me.
lines.zh: : 你还没意识到的事情多着呢，老师。而且大多数都是关于我的。

lines.en: : That is very hard to believe with how open you have been since we started sleeping together.
lines.zh: : 从我们开始睡在一起以来你一直这么坦白，这可很难让人相信。

lines.en: : And yet, you’ve only had a little taste of the depravity I have to offer. How sad.
lines.zh: : 然而，我所拥有的堕落，你才只尝到一点点。多可悲。

lines.en: : How much more depraved can you get than losing your virginity ten feet away from Niki? Or partaking in one of Nodoka’s sex contests with Molly?
lines.zh: : 比在离 Niki 十英尺的地方失去童贞更堕落？还是比参加 Nodoka 和 Molly 的性爱比赛更堕落？

lines.en: : Very. For example, I’ve yet to fuck you at school. Which is almost entirely due to the fact that you don’t show up anymore. But it’d be pretty naughty to ride you during homeroom, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 要堕落得多。比如，我还没在学校和你做过。这几乎完全是因为你不再出现了。不过要在晨会的时候骑在你身上，是不是挺坏的呢？

lines.en: : It would also be impossible with nineteen other girls actively tearing you to shreds.
lines.zh: : 在另外十九个女孩都忙着把你撕成碎片的情况下，那也是不可能的。

lines.en: : Then here’s another one — I’ve yet to have a threesome with you and my mom yet.
lines.zh: : 那再来一个——我还没和你、还有我妈来过三人行。

lines.en: : You’ve had a total of one threesome and it’s the one I just mentioned. Plus, there is a 0%% chance your mom would ever even think of doing something like that with you.
lines.zh: : 你总共就经历过一次三人行，也就是我刚才提到的那次。再说，你妈会愿意和你做那种事的概率是 0%%。

lines.en: scene sanasenseicouchbar26
: I can promise you it’s much higher than 0%%, Sensei. Us Sakakibara girls are quite naughty if you haven’t noticed yet.
